observations.risk: Storage shelving, large barrel, posts and wall/bench occupy the building frontage. Visible stone fragments behind them must not automatically count as a continuous passage.
observations.requiredCheck: Build collision footprints at the feet of the barrel, shelves and posts, then test entry approach and the route around the barrel with the actual actor radius.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

observations.risk: Large boat hull, ribs, canopy and interior benches dominate the lower region. Rendered timber surface is not evidence of traversable town ground; several apparent channels stop at ribs or gunwales.
observations.requiredCheck: Declare whether boat interior is accessible and on which navigation elevation, with explicit boarding connection. Otherwise exclude hull/canopy/boat interior from the town walkable mask.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

observations.risk: Two worktables, barrels, projecting column bases and building frontage narrow the wooden deck into local passages. A broad image area includes vertical facade and furniture, not only free ground.
observations.requiredCheck: Preserve an uninterrupted route in front of the furniture after radius erosion; verify doorway reachability rather than treating table undersides or occluded backdrop as clear floor.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

observations.risk: Diagonal deck/boat edge and a small timber pile constrain the lower route. Art continuity across the tile border does not establish navigation between elevated deck and ground below.
observations.requiredCheck: Mark deck edge as an elevation/obstacle boundary unless a defined staircase or ramp connects it. Include loose timber in collision if actors cannot pass through it.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

observations.risk: Multiple tables, canopy posts, column bases and the right net barrier form short narrow passages. Canopy/table pixels are visually large and must not inflate free-area estimates; route bottlenecks matter more than aggregate ground area.
observations.requiredCheck: Use footprint geometry and actor radius to measure minimum clear widths around each base/table and between the front/back tables. Explicitly reserve a through route instead of assuming all visible wooden gaps connect.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

observations.risk: Boat hull, angled supports, stools, bucket and rack cover much of the ground. Small visible stone pockets under hull/furniture may be disconnected or too narrow after collision clearance.
observations.requiredCheck: Exclude under-hull/support pockets unless intentionally navigable; verify a continuous route along the foreground and connections to neighboring tiles at the same ground level.
observations.boxMeaning: Approximate visual review envelope; not a measured minimum width, polygon mask or proposed repaint boundary.

interpretation: These are local candidate-art observations. Existing road/floor projection alone cannot establish physical walking width or 5000-player capacity. Root latest gate records a trial of 5000 static feet positions with corridor reservation, but also states worldSizeApproved=false and fullRuntimePassed=false; this report does not override or release that gate.
missingForMetricWidth: Approved worldSize and map-to-world ground-plane mapping

recommendedNextDecision: Root should validate actor-cleared paths at the listed frontage/boat/table bottlenecks against the approved layout before authorizing expansion. Do not infer a whole-map enlargement or a repaint solely from raster resolution.
